title: Volvo’s cars will warn one another about hazards in the road
summary: Volvo is updating three of its electric vehicles with new hazard alerts to warn drivers when there are animals or vulnerable road users ahead. The new connected safety features are based on Volvo's cars talking to one another, as opposed to crowdsourced alert systems used by popular navigation tools
author: Andrew J. Hawkins
